headline: Maven school-strike report and Trump's 'hoax' remark lift Self-Destruction
body: A darker day. Bloomberg reported that faulty intelligence and over-reliance on Palantir's Maven AI contributed to a February strike on an Iranian school that killed 123 children; Palantir disputes it. Military AI linked to real harm raises Catastrophic Risk and weakens Alignment & Control, the two biggest drivers of Self-Destruction, the ending where humanity wrecks itself before superintelligence arrives. President Trump, meanwhile, vowed an 'AI Force' and an AI czar while calling safety warnings a 'hoax'. That signals less appetite for coordination and safety work, which hit Gatekeeper, the ending that depends on nations cooperating to cap AI. A new music-label lawsuit against Suno added a sliver of backlash. Horizon Balance fell 1.23 points to -8.38.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +1.5 (Maven report +1.03, Trump +0.49), Gatekeeper -0.9 (Trump -0.70, Maven -0.24) and Libertarian Utopia -0.8 (Maven -0.60, Trump -0.20).
